name: Zen
note: The page prints Ctrl and Alt and does not say how they map on macOS; they are read as ⌘ and ⌥, as in Firefox, which Zen is built on. Re-check on a Mac with Zen installed.

goBack.from: Navigate Back (Alternative) (Ctrl+[); the primary Alt+Left is the macOS word-movement key

goForward.from: Navigate Forward (Alternative) (Ctrl+]); the primary Alt+Right is the macOS word-movement key

unbound.focusTabList: The page lists no command to move the focus to the sidebar.
unbound.previousTab: The page lists no previous-tab command (only Show All Tabs, Shift+Ctrl+Tab).
unbound.nextTab: The page lists no next-tab command (only Show All Tabs, Shift+Ctrl+Tab).
unbound.moveTabUp: The page lists no command to move a tab.
unbound.moveTabDown: The page lists no command to move a tab.
